repo.name: typeorm
repo.note: TypeORM ORM library, 496 src/*.ts files, 1108 indexed symbols, 2750 file-level edges - replaces the earlier 35-file nestjs-realworld target, which was too small for a compelling grep baseline (plan §12: 'benchmark repo choice matters'). tsconfig.rie.json is a self-contained config added for indexing (upstream tsconfig extends @tsconfig/node20, which needs node_modules; ours doesn't). Oracles below were verified with independent grep ground-truth, not engine output alone.

protocol.note: Fresh session per run (fresh --session-id, no --continue/--resume); baseline and assisted for a task never share a session (plan §8/B).
